reason: Groups all users with more than 10 posts under one constant key and averages UpVotes and the optional Age (nulls skipped), giving one row of the two averages.
Each average is taken over users with more than 10 posts (age only over those with an age), giving one row of the two averages, the same as a plain per-user average.
Divides the age sum by the count of all qualifying users, including those with no recorded age, so the age figure is understated compared with the average age.
